record.name: Madagascar
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. No standalone national AI strategy was located. AI features in the 2023-2028 digital strategic plan, and a 2024 agreement aimed to launch a feasibility study for an applied-AI institute for the Indian Ocean region.

check.language_note: The recorded fr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: MG-search = searches 1, 2 (en, fr). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Different events covered by two publishers do not establish sufficiently independent institutional corroboration in the retrieved evidence. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.

record.notes:
The institute proposed in the earlier June 2024 account concerns training and applied AI.

The government reform programme describes preparation of judicial AI rules and involvement of the data-protection commission. Searches covered indexed public English and French sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
